native_delta.description: Only private SHA word helpers use the low four bytes of each existing eight-byte scratch slot; stores preserve all eight bytes with zero high half. All original analyzer parsing, receipts, inventory, graph, report formatting and diagnostic behavior is byte-identical source.
invariants: Exact original SHA author Git b59c2259f038eab830c16bf498b14a5d15556ee4 initializes all64 ROUND slots and8 INITIAL slots with32-bit constants.
Every message schedule word is either four input bytes or an explicit sum masked with4294967295; every compression/state update is masked with4294967295.
Every SHA word read has been initialized on every invocation/block before that read; upper four bytes are zero.
hash_get/hash_put are private to SHA compression; ordinary64-bit JSON/state get/put helpers remain unchanged.
Stored upper halves remain zero, preserving the original complete scratch bytes; no work buffer region or capacity changes.
